rationale: The plan rigorously implements the approved Daedalus-family lifecycle design while strictly honoring existing governance boundaries. It successfully preserves the existing TELOS authorization trio (claude/agy/codex) while mandating Grok and Gemini exclusively within the P2 and C2 profile gates, cleanly separating profile consensus from TELOS authority. The fail-closed Node ESM architecture, strict Merkle-DAG append-only decision storage, deterministic state transitions completely lacking automatic caps, and strict prohibition of required-seat substitution provide a robust and auditable foundation. The synthetic end-to-end tests, deterministic provider adapters, and dependency-free disk-truth derivations provide a highly verifiable and secure implementation blueprint that never conflates model agreement with Eye authorization.
